en.headline: Police arrest 10 over fake model ads used to open mule accounts
en.dek: Officers say a syndicate used job ads to control e-wallet accounts linked to 43 deception cases.
body: Police have arrested five men and five women, aged 13 to 68, on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud and money laundering, over a syndicate that used fake model-recruitment advertisements to open mule accounts. Officers said the operation involved 43 deception cases.

Police said the group posted the advertisements on social platforms between October 2024 and May this year, telling jobseekers to register e-wallet accounts with phone numbers supplied by the syndicate so wages could be paid. The accounts were then controlled as mule accounts. At least eight of them received money from at least 43 online-shopping and compensated-dating deception cases, involving more than 2.16 million dollars. Police also put the losses at more than 800,000 dollars. The 43 victims were 13 men and 30 women; some had fallen for concert-ticket scams, and about 60 per cent were students.

Three of those arrested are suspected core members. Police said they transferred most of the proceeds through several accounts into personal accounts, then spent the money at a high-end massage shop, a tertiary-college canteen and clinics. A man and a woman among them are students at a local tertiary institution and are believed to be a couple. Officers seized 17 mobile phones, two computers, three routers and more than 40,000 dollars in cash, and intercepted 3.5 million dollars of suspected proceeds in one member's account.

Police urged the public not to hand bank or e-wallet accounts to strangers, and not to register a personal account with a phone number supplied by someone else. They said online job ads promising no experience, high pay or quick money are often scams.

zh.headline: 假模特兒招聘誘開傀儡戶口 警拘10人
zh.dek: 警方指集團以招聘廣告操控電子錢包，涉及43宗騙案。
body: 警方拘捕5男5女，年齡介乎13至68歲，涉嫌串謀詐騙及洗黑錢。警方說，集團以虛假模特兒招聘廣告誘使求職者開立電子錢包，再把戶口用作傀儡戶口，涉及43宗騙案。
警方表示，集團於2024年10月至今年5月在社交平台發布廣告，以方便出糧為由，要求求職者用集團提供的電話號碼登記電子錢包，藉此操控戶口。至少8個傀儡戶口收取至少43宗網購及援交騙案款項，涉款逾216萬元；警方同時稱損失逾80萬元。43名受害人包括13男30女，部分涉演唱會門票騙案，約六成是學生。
被捕人士中有3人疑為骨幹。警方說，他們把大部分款項輾轉轉入個人戶口，再用於高級按摩店、專上學院餐廳及診所等消費。當中一男一女是本地大專院校學生，相信是情侶。行動檢獲17部手機、2部電腦、3部路由器及逾4萬元現金，並在其中一名成員的戶口攔截350萬元懷疑涉案資金。
警方呼籲市民不要把銀行或電子錢包戶口交由陌生人操控，亦不要用他人提供的電話號碼登記個人戶口。標榜毋須經驗、人工高或「搵快錢」的網上招聘，往往是騙局。
